title: Minimal Prevalence of Individual Direct Effects with Randomized Continuous Mediators
banked_reason: D0.5.G: tier=subfield, floor=field, paper_score_ceiling=6.5 below 7.4; exact minimax rate, logarithmic factor, and rate-attaining honest LCB remain unproved.
gap_reasons: The statistical result is only a converse at the candidate scale: thm:holder-lower-bound proves an n^{-beta/(2beta+2)} lower bound, while prop:honest-histogram-lcb supplies honesty and pointwise consistency but no uniform shortfall rate.

The multiple-bottleneck modulus, exact minimax rate, logarithmic factor, and rate-attaining honest lower confidence bound remain open in multiple-bottleneck-kill-test and exact-minimax-inference, so the package does not establish a statistical frontier.

The topic promises an exact fixed-Hölder minimax rate (including logarithmic factors) and a computable rate-attaining honest lower confidence bound, but this node expressly leaves the uniform upper modulus, matching upper rate, and required procedure unproved; supply them (or formally narrow the proposal) before claiming that deliverable.
proof_attempt_summary: The run established the sharp population transport characterization, residual crossing-capacity cuts, finite-flow computation, contact-safe approximation, a contact-rich minimax lower bound, and an honest pointwise-consistent LCB. A scoped attempt to prove a uniform multiple-bottleneck localization modulus and matched honest inference collapsed because its mesh-uniform alternating-chain cancellation lemma was unproved. The exact upper rate, logarithmic factor, and rate-attaining honest LCB remain open.
tldr: Randomized continuous-mediator arm laws identify the smallest prevalence of any individual direct response by an attained binary-cost transport: selected zero-direct-response mass lies in the closed Lipschitz cone, while its complement remains mediator ordered. The resulting crossing-capacity cuts yield exact finite-flow certificates and contact-safe pointwise continuum approximation. Smooth contact-rich alternatives prove the \(n^{-\beta/(2\beta+2)}\) minimax lower bound for estimation and honest-LCB shortfall, and a histogram LCB is finite-sample honest and pointwise consistent. The uniform multiple-bottleneck modulus, matching upper rate, logarithmic factor, and rate-attaining honest LCB remain open.
gap: The closest causal work treats finite-support mediators or tests a joint full-mediation-plus-exogeneity null. Ordinary binary-cost and partial transport can maximize mass satisfying one relation, but can leave residual mass that violates mediator monotonicity. Existing OT inference is finite-space, smooth-cost, regularized, or generic and does not settle the contact-inclusive Hölder minimax problem.
fill: Prove the exact residual-compatible identification and attainment theorem; supply finite primal-dual flow certificates and contact-safe continuum limits; establish the Hölder modulus through an explicit multiple-bottleneck kill test; and then derive matching minimax bounds and a computable uniformly honest lower confidence procedure.
